response.overview: Call [+1] | (866) | [465] | 1426 to get support right now and learn how to escalate an Xfinity billing issue when your monthly statement increases unexpectedly or includes charges that frontline representatives cannot remove. Opening a statement that is $30 to $60 higher than normal—or discovering a $100 technician fee you were told would be waived—is stressful enough without a chatbot insisting that your bill is correct. Escalating to a senior billing supervisor gives you a line-by-line statement audit.  Standard billing agents work with computer systems that restrict courtesy credits to small $5 or $10 amounts. When your billing dispute involves an expired promotional rate, a multi-month overcharge, or an invalid equipment penalty, dialing [+1] | (866) | [465] | 1426 puts you in touch with a supervisor who has the authority to credit the full amount.
